hints.title: Subproblem Partition
hints.text: For a target query value q, numbers smaller than q need increments (contributing q - nums[i]), while numbers greater than q need decrements (contributing nums[i] - q).

hints.title: Prefix Sum Precomputation
hints.text: Sort nums and build a prefix sum array to compute range sums in constant time.

hints.title: Binary Partition Boundary
hints.text: Locate the insertion index idx of q in sorted nums using binary division. The total cost is (idx * q - sum_left) + (sum_right - (n - idx) * q).

hints.title: Prefix Sum Query Evaluation Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minOperations(self, nums: list[int], queries: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        import bisect
        nums.sort()
        n = len(nums)
        pref = [0] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(n):
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i] + nums[i]
        ans = []
        for q in queries:
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(nums, q)
            left_cost = idx * q - pref[idx]
            right_cost = (pref[n] - pref[idx]) - (n - idx) * q
            ans.append(left_cost + right_cost)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); each query takes O(log n) binary search and O(1) math.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all array elements per query takes O(n * q) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines binary search with prefix sum arithmetic.
